title: Kanohar Electricals IPO Details
intro:
Kanohar Electricals IPO is a book build issue of ₹1,055.74 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 47.47 lakh shares aggregating to ₹300.00 crores and offer for sale of 1.20 crore shares aggregating to ₹755.74 crores.

Kanohar Electricals IPO bidding opened for subscription on Sep 8, 2026 and will close on Sep 10, 2026. The allotment for the Kanohar Electricals IPO is expected to be finalized on Sep 11, 2026. Kanohar Electricals IPO will list on NSE and BSE with a tentative listing date fixed as Sep 16, 2026.

Kanohar Electricals IPO is set issue price band at ₹601 to ₹632 per share. The lot size for an application is 23 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹14,536 (23 shares) (based on upper price).

Nuvama Wealth Management Ltd. is the book running lead manager and MUFG Intime India Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue.

Refer to Kanohar Electricals IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 1972, Kanohar Electricals Limited is engaged in the manufacturing of transformers in India. The Company caters to industries such as power transmission, railways, renewable energy and power distribution.

The Company operates through two business segments: (i) transformer manufacturing and (ii) engineering, procurement and construction (EPC). It is one of four manufacturers in India certified by the Research Designs and Standards Organisation (RDSO), the research and development arm of Indian Railways, for manufacturing 100 MVA 132 kV Scott transformers.

Kanohar Electricals Limited operates two manufacturing facilities in Rithani, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh (“Rithani Manufacturing Facility”) and Gangol, Meerut, Uttar Pradesh (“Gangol Manufacturing Facility” and collectively with Rithani Manufacturing Facility, “Manufacturing Facilities”) with an aggregate transformer manufacturing capacity of 19,200 MVA as on March 31, 2026.

The Company has five regional offices located in NCT of Delhi, Mumbai, Maharashtra, Kolkata, West Bengal, Bangalore, Karnataka, and Chennai, Tamil Nadu, and a team of over 526 employees to cater to our customers across India.

faqs.question: How to apply in Kanohar Electricals IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Kanohar Electricals IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Kanohar Electricals IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Kanohar Electricals IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Kanohar Electricals IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Kanohar Electricals IPO?
faqs.answer: Kanohar Electricals IPO lot size is 23 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹14,536 .

faqs.question: How to apply for Kanohar Electricals IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Kanohar Electricals IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Kanohar Electricals IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Kanohar Electricals IPO will be done on Friday, September 11, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Tue, Sep 15, 2026 . Check the Kanohar Electricals IPO allotment status .

faqs.question: When is Kanohar Electricals IPO listing date ?
faqs.answer: The Kanohar Electricals IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Wed, Sep 16, 2026 .
